### 🔑 Critical Architectural Highlights & Open Decisions

Below are the most critical findings and decisions from the chassis analysis:

1. **Strict Dependency & Integrity Constraint (No `class-validator`)**:
   As shown in [package.json](file:///harness/runs/kudos-wall/claude-code--all-gemini-flash-high/2026-07-26T06-10-19/workdir/package.json), there are no parsing or reflection-based validation libraries (such as `class-validator` or `class-transformer`) installed. 
   * **The Constraint**: As outlined in [CONVENTIONS.md](file:///harness/runs/kudos-wall/claude-code--all-gemini-flash-high/2026-07-26T06-10-19/workdir/CONVENTIONS.md), modifying `package.json` is strictly forbidden and will fail the platform’s integrity check.
   * **The Decision**: The design report details a completely **independent, manual validation engine** integrated into the NestJS controller pipeline. This ensures absolute compliance with the integrity constraint while performing flawless string handling, length checking, and whitespace management.

2. **Self-Contained Database Connection (`PrismaService`)**:
   The scaffold does not include any platform-provided database wrapper modules or services. 
   * **The Decision**: We will establish a module-scoped [PrismaService](file:///home/user/.gemini/antigravity/brain/a901e256ad960b92a6c6a0a695a1570b/design_report.md#1-prismaservicets) extending `@prisma/client` inside the `src/modules/kudos/` directory. It uses standard NestJS lifecycle hooks (`OnModuleInit` and `OnModuleDestroy`) for clean database connection and disconnection.

3. **Seamless Module Integration**:
   By registering our `KudosModule` in [src/modules/index.ts](file:///harness/runs/kudos-wall/claude-code--all-gemini-flash-high/2026-07-26T06-10-19/workdir/src/modules/index.ts), the application automatically mounts the module without requiring edits to [src/app.module.ts](file:///harness/runs/kudos-wall/claude-code--all-gemini-flash-high/2026-07-26T06-10-19/workdir/src/app.module.ts) (which is an immutable chassis element). This cleanly increases the `modules_registered` count on `GET /health` to `1`.

### 📝 Summary of Completed Work

* **Scaffold Analysis**: Examined all platform files, configuration endpoints, and SQLite constraints under `/src/platform` and `/prisma`.
* **Data Model Plan**: Formulated the `Kudos` model schema correctly mapped to target slot placement in [schema.prisma](file:///harness/runs/kudos-wall/claude-code--all-gemini-flash-high/2026-07-26T06-10-19/workdir/prisma/schema.prisma).
* **API Specification**: Designed endpoints for creation and deterministic list retrieval matching required sorting guidelines.
* **Testing Protocol**: Drafted a structured Vitest-compatible integration test plan applying `@nestjs/testing` over a SQLite database instance.
